title: Does Code Cleanliness Affect Coding Agents?
ai_summary:
• Researchers explored how code cleanliness affects AI-powered code completion and review tools (coding agents).
• Agents performed better with well-structured, readable code, but struggled with messy or poorly commented codebases.
• Cleanliness metrics, such as cyclomatic complexity and Halstead complexity, were correlated with AI-assisted coding efficiency.
student_angle: Learn software engineering best practices like code organization, commenting, and testing for better AI collaboration.
